title: running a module without main does not succeed
purpose: An executable run requires an entry point; library modules may omit main only when imported.

failure.justification: spec 3 requires an entry point for executable modules but does not state whether its absence is diagnosed statically or when execution starts; no program code exists to run either way.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 3: executable modules MUST declare exactly one entry point; a run without one cannot complete.
